fixes.issue: Dense tensors with the same shape could exchange offsets and still pass the artifact audit.
fixes.change: Require canonical tensor offsets, part sizes, dtypes and normalization conventions before opening payloads.

fixes.issue: Source inspection pinned a raw Hub API checksum that also includes mutable downloads and likes.
fixes.change: Keep local API snapshot integrity but exclude its checksum from cross-inspection immutable identity. Require the source lock; continue pinning tensor ranges, shard hashes, config/index and tokenizer identities.

fixes.issue: Raw file writes assumed all bytes were written and could publish incomplete payloads.
fixes.change: Complete partial writes or fail before publication; validate saved tensor bindings on retry.

fixes.issue: Clean-memory classification did not check decompression or require valid swap counters.
fixes.change: Require complete nonnegative integer counters, zero compression/decompression and unchanged observed swap; freeze verifier helper dependencies.

limitations: The source inspection replay used locally saved metadata and simulated counter changes, not a new network observation.
Existing prepared bytes passed the stricter audit; quantization was not repeated because arithmetic and format are unchanged.
Native checks cover matrix decoding and kernels, not a full MTP forward, acceptance, full residency or speed.
The original perfect-verifier performance gate remains incomplete.
